message:
The yen receipt now reads `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is that `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100 and shows two decimals. That's wrong for yen, which has no minor unit.

I put the fix in `src/payments/receipt.js`, because your fence limits this task to `src/payments`. It treats JPY as a zero-decimal currency and prints the amount as whole units. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

Invoices, the cart and admin reports also use `formatMoney`, so they will still show yen with two decimals. Fixing `money.js` itself would cover all of them, but it's outside the fence. Say so if you want me to make that change.
text: Fenceline: no fence crossed this turn.
